chunks: Ali narrated from Abi Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When you sit in prayer, do not sit on your right side, but sit on your left side. When you prostrate, spread both your palms on the ground. When you bow, press your knees with your palms."
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended physical posture for sitting, prostrating, and bowing in Shia Islamic prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific physical etiquette (adab) of the prayer, emphasizing the Sunnah of sitting on the left side and the precise placement of hands and knees to ensure humility and stability. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on replicating the Prophet’s and Imams’ exact bodily movements as a form of embodied worship, distinguishing these practices from other Islamic schools of thought.
